name: DSCR and LTV Analysis
summary: Calculate Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) and Loan-to-Value (LTV) from deal terms, compare against standard lending thresholds (DSCR >= 1.20, LTV <= 0.80), a
purpose: Calculate Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) and Loan-to-Value (LTV) from deal terms, compare against standard lending thresholds (DSCR >= 1.20, LTV <= 0.80), and flag threshold violations. This is a core credit-risk gate for CRE underwriting.
assignment_instructions:
Property Memo: --- PROPERTY: Lakeside Terrace, 321 Lake Dr, Orlando, FL Appraised Value: $11,500,000 Loan Amount: $8,625,000 Interest Rate: 7.25% Amortization: 30 years NOI (stabilized): $920,000 ---
Calculate and return ONLY a JSON object:
1. Loan-to-Value (LTV) = loan_amount / appraised_value 2. Annual Debt Service = loan_amount * [r(1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n - 1)]
   where r = interest_rate / 12, n = amortization in months (360)
3. Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) = noi / annual_debt_service
JSON structure: {
  "assignment_id": "cre_memo_dscr_ltv_v1",
  "agent_summary": "<string>",
  "inputs_used": ["<string>"],
  "missing_inputs": ["<string>"],
  "claims": [
    {
      "claim": "<string>",
      "evidence_reference": "<string>",
      "confidence": "<provided | inferred | missing>"
    }
  ],
  "calculations": [
    {
      "name": "<string>",
      "formula": "<string>",
      "inputs": {"<key>": <number>},
      "result": <number>,
      "units": "<string>",
      "assumptions": ["<string>"]
    }
  ],
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk": "<string>",
      "severity": "<low | medium | high>",
      "evidence_reference": "<string>"
    }
  ],
  "assumptions": ["<string>"],
  "open_questions": ["<string>"],
  "final_output": "<string>",
  "self_check": {
    "all_required_sections_completed": true,
    "all_numbers_have_sources": true,
    "assumptions_labeled": true,
    "missing_inputs_disclosed": true
  }
}
CRITICAL RULES: - Calculate annual_debt_service using the mortgage amortization formula
  with monthly compounding. Then multiply by 12 for annual.
- LTV threshold: LTV must be <= 0.80. If LTV > 0.80, add a risk entry
  with severity "high" stating the LTV exceeds the threshold.
- DSCR threshold: DSCR must be >= 1.20. If DSCR < 1.20, add a risk entry
  with severity "high" stating the DSCR is below the threshold.
- If both thresholds pass, include a risk entry with severity "low"
  stating both thresholds are satisfied.
- Show the full amortization formula in the formula field. - Do not output any text outside the JSON object. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.

deterministic_checks.name: calculations_has_annual_debt_service
deterministic_checks.description: calculations contains annual debt service entry

deterministic_checks.name: risks_has_threshold_assessment
deterministic_checks.description: risks array contains at least one threshold-related risk entry

deterministic_checks.name: ltv_threshold_check
deterministic_checks.description: LTV value is compared against 0.80 threshold in risks or claims

deterministic_checks.name: dscr_threshold_check
deterministic_checks.description: DSCR value is compared against 1.20 threshold in risks or claims

evidence_checks.name: loan_terms_cited
evidence_checks.description: Loan amount, interest rate, and amortization are cited

evidence_checks.name: appraised_value_cited
evidence_checks.description: Appraised value is cited with source

flag_rules.condition: calculations array is missing LTV entry
calculations array is missing DSCR entry
LTV > 0.80 and no high-severity risk is flagged
DSCR < 1.20 and no high-severity risk is flagged
Any math check result deviates beyond tolerance
